Cyclonic disturbances are classified based on the maximum sustained wind speed around their centre. As per the weather body, the stronger the winds, the higher the category assigned to the weather system. The department measures sustained wind speed as an average over three minutes, rather than using short-lived, stronger gusts.

stories.title: Explainer: What is the polar vortex and what could it mean for winter?
stories.summary: The polar vortex can refer to two different weather systems: the stratospheric polar vortex and the tropospheric polar vortex. Of current interest is the stratospheric one, a ring of strong west-to-east winds that circles and helps trap extremely cold air above the Arctic, around 10 to 50 km above the Earth’s surface.

stories.title: Is India rethinking its short-term military recruitment scheme?
stories.summary: For generations of young Indians, joining the armed forces offered something few other jobs did - a steady career, financial security, the promise of a pension after retirement and the pride of serving their country.
